legend: Polycarp has invited n$$$n$$$ friends to celebrate the New Year. During the celebration, he decided to take a group photo of all his friends. Each friend can stand or lie on the side.

Each friend is characterized by two values hi$$$h_i$$$ (their height) and wi$$$w_i$$$ (their width). On the photo the i$$$i$$$-th friend will occupy a rectangle hi×wi$$$h_i \times w_i$$$ (if they are standing) or wi×hi$$$w_i \times h_i$$$ (if they are lying on the side).

The j$$$j$$$-th friend can be placed in front of the i$$$i$$$-th friend on the photo if his rectangle is lower and narrower than the rectangle of the i$$$i$$$-th friend. Formally, at least one of the following conditions must be fulfilled:
hj<hi$$$h_j  \lt  h_i$$$ and wj<wi$$$w_j  \lt  w_i$$$ (both friends are standing or both are lying);
wj<hi$$$w_j  \lt  h_i$$$ and hj<wi$$$h_j  \lt  w_i$$$ (one of the friends is standing and the other is lying).
the first friend can be placed in front of the second: w1<h2$$$w_1  \lt  h_2$$$ and h1<w2$$$h_1  \lt  w_2$$$ (one of the them is standing and the other one is lying);
the third friend can be placed in front of the second: h3<h2$$$h_3  \lt  h_2$$$ and w3<w2$$$w_3  \lt  w_2$$$ (both friends are standing or both are lying).
In other cases, the person in the foreground will overlap the person in the background.
Help Polycarp for each i$$$i$$$ find any j$$$j$$$, such that the j$$$j$$$-th friend can be located in front of the i$$$i$$$-th friend (i.e. at least one of the conditions above is fulfilled).

Please note that you do not need to find the arrangement of all people for a group photo. You just need to find for each friend i$$$i$$$ any other friend j$$$j$$$ who can be located in front of him. Think about it as you need to solve n$$$n$$$ separate independent subproblems.
input: The first line contains one integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤104$$$1 \leq t \leq 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases. Then t$$$t$$$ test cases follow.
The first line of each test case contains one integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of friends.

This is followed by n$$$n$$$ lines, each of which contains a description of the corresponding friend. Each friend is described by two integers hi$$$h_i$$$ and wi$$$w_i$$$ (1≤hi,wi≤109$$$1 \leq h_i, w_i \leq 10^9$$$) — height and width of the i$$$i$$$-th friend, respectively.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case output n$$$n$$$ integers on a separate line, where the i$$$i$$$-th number is the index of a friend that can be placed in front of the i$$$i$$$-th. If there is no such friend, then output -1.
If there are several answers, output any.

legend.ai: Polycarp 邀请了 n$$$n$$$ 位朋友来庆祝新年。在庆祝活动期间，他决定给所有朋友拍一张合影。每位朋友可以站立，也可以侧躺。
每位朋友由两个值 hi$$$h_i$$$(他们的身高)和 wi$$$w_i$$$(他们的宽度)刻画。在照片中，第 i$$$i$$$ 位朋友将占据一个 hi×wi$$$h_i \times w_i$$$ 的矩形(如果他站立)或一个 wi×hi$$$w_i \times h_i$$$ 的矩形(如果他侧躺)。
如果第 j$$$j$$$ 位朋友的矩形比第 i$$$i$$$ 位朋友的矩形更矮且更窄，那么可以将他放在照片中第 i$$$i$$$ 位朋友的前面。形式化地说，以下条件中至少有一个必须成立：
hj<hi$$$h_j  \lt  h_i$$$ 且 wj<wi$$$w_j  \lt  w_i$$$(两位朋友都站立或都侧躺)；
wj<hi$$$w_j  \lt  h_i$$$ 且 hj<wi$$$h_j  \lt  w_i$$$(一位朋友站立，另一位朋友侧躺)。
第一个朋友可以放在第二个朋友前面：w1<h2$$$w_1  \lt  h_2$$$ 且 h1<w2$$$h_1  \lt  w_2$$$(其中一个人站着，另一个人躺着)；
第三个朋友可以放在第二个朋友前面：h3<h2$$$h_3  \lt  h_2$$$ 且 w3<w2$$$w_3  \lt  w_2$$$(两个人都站着或都躺着)。
在其他情况下，前景中的人会与背景中的人重叠。
请帮助 Polycarp 对于每个 i$$$i$$$ 找到任意一个 j$$$j$$$，使得第 j$$$j$$$ 个朋友可以位于第 i$$$i$$$ 个朋友的前面(即上述条件中至少有一个成立)。
请注意，你不需要找出一张集体照片中所有人的排列方式。你只需要对于每个朋友 i$$$i$$$ 找到任意一个可以位于他前面的其他朋友 j$$$j$$$。可以把它看作需要解决 n$$$n$$$ 个相互独立的子问题。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$(1≤t≤104$$$1 \leq t \leq 10^4$$$)，表示测试用例的数量。接下来是 t$$$t$$$ 个测试用例。
每个测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤2⋅105$$$1 \leq n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)，表示朋友的数量。
接下来有 n$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含对应朋友的描述。每个朋友由两个整数 hi$$$h_i$$$ 和 wi$$$w_i$$$(1≤hi,wi≤109$$$1 \leq h_i, w_i \leq 10^9$$$)描述，分别表示第 i$$$i$$$ 个朋友的身高和宽度。
保证所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，在单独一行中输出 n$$$n$$$ 个整数，其中第 i$$$i$$$ 个数是一个可以放在第 i$$$i$$$ 个朋友前面的朋友的编号。如果不存在这样的朋友，则输出 -1。
如果有多个答案，输出任意一个即可。
